202.text: 那些僵尸不会减弱攻势吧？
202.original: Those zombies just won't let up, will they?

203.text: 你会注意到和僵尸作战在夜间不同于白天之处。
203.original: You'll notice that fighting zombies at night is different than in the day.

204.text: 首先，你不能从天上得到阳光。
204.original: For one, you won't get any sun falling from the sky.

205.text: 但你仍可以通过向日葵来获得阳光。
205.original: You can still get sun from sunflowers, though.

206.text: 并且你很幸运，你得到了小喷菇。
206.original: And lucky for you, you got yourself some puff-shrooms.

207.text: 尽可能多地种植这些蘑菇吧，你会挺过去的。
207.original: Plant as many of those as you can and you'll be A-O-GOOD.

301.text: 嘿，你找到了我的车钥匙！
301.original: Hey, you found my car key!

303.text: 疯狂戴夫的“花哨小玩意”正式营业了！
303.original: Crazy Dave's Twiddydinkies is open for business! {MOUTH_SMALL_SMILE}

304.text: 瞧一瞧！你是否找到了一些你喜欢的东西！
304.original: Have a look! See if you can't find something you like! {MOUTH_SMALL_SMILE}

401.text: 玩过“敲击僵尸”的游戏吗？
401.original: Ever play a game called Whack-a-Zombie?

403.text: 你看，那些毛茸茸的小老鼠是在你的草坪里打洞吗？
403.original: You know, those furry little rodents that dig holes in your lawn?

404.text: 耶，就像那样，但不是鼹鼠，而是僵尸。
404.original: Yeah, just like that, but instead of squirbos, it's zombies.

405.original: {SHOW_HAMMER}And instead of a shovel, it's a mallet.

406.original: And instead of ME, it's YOU! {MOUTH_BIG_SMILE} {SCREAM}

501.text: 看来僵尸们要放弃进攻你的前院了。
501.original: Looks like the zombies gave up attacking your front yard.

502.text: 现在他们想试试你的后院。

503.text: 但最重要的是你不能使用你的蘑菇了！
503.original: And to top it all off, you can't even use your mushrooms!

504.text: 因为他们白天时要睡觉！
504.original: 'cause they'll fall asleep during the day!

505.text: 这难道不是花花公子的作风吗？

701.text: 僵尸的进攻计划其实是件有趣的事情。有时他们会来的很少。
701.original: Funny thing about the zombie process. Sometimes it makes 'em come out real little.

801.text: 你知道，他们曾叫我“迷雾男”。
801.original: You know, they used to call me "Fog Man"

802.text: 因为我曾停留在雾中并突然从人群中跳出！
802.original: 'cause I would hang out in the fog and JUMP OUT AT PEOPLE! {MOUTH_BIG_SMILE}

1101.text: 怎么突然间变得这么暗了？
1101.original: Why'd it get so dark all of a sudden?

1102.text: 噢，这可不是什么好预兆啊。

1103.text: 嗯，好吧，希望你能活过今晚！
1103.original: Oh well, hope you survive the night!

1201.text: 哇——！他们甚至在你的屋顶上找到条路！
1201.original: Whoa! They even found a way onto your roof!

1202.original: Those are some persistent zombies, dude.

1203.text: 考虑到你屋顶的角度，你会需要用到卷心菜的。
1203.original: You'll need to use cabbage-pults here due to your roof's angle.

1204.text: 记住这点，你会平安无事的！
1204.original: Remember that, and you're good to go!

1305.original: You are going to hate this next level.

1306.text: 为什么？ 因为接下来是一个接一个的蹦极僵尸。
1306.original: Why?  Because it's non-stop bungee zombie after bungee zombie.

1307.text: 我讨厌这些困惑的蹦极僵尸!!!

1309.text: 讨厌他们有着那种激情！

1311.text: 哇—靠——！他们中的精英来了！
1311.original: A-Whoop-a-dee-doo! Here come those idiots now!

1401.text: 嘿，你目前已经收集了 {MONEY} 枚金币！
1401.original: Hey, you've collected {MONEY} in coins so far!

1402.text: 当你收集到 {UPGRADE_COST}时， 我会卖给你一些实用的东西哦！
1402.original: When you collect {UPGRADE_COST}, I'll sell you something really neat-o!

1501.text: 嘿！想增加一个额外的植物槽吗？
1501.original: Hey! Wanna buy an extra seed slot?

1502.text: 这将花费你 {UPGRADE_COST}，但你每关能选7种植物而不是6种！
1502.original: It'll cost you {UPGRADE_COST}, but you'll be able to choose 7 seeds per level instead of 6!

1510.text: 太好了！然后当你攒到{UPGRADE_COST}，我将给你升级到8个植物槽！
1510.original: All right! And hey, when you save up to {UPGRADE_COST}, I'll sell you the 8-seed slot upgrade!

1551.text: 嘿！想增加个额外的植物槽吗？
1551.original: Hey! Wanna buy an extra seed slot?

1552.text: 这将花费你{UPGRADE_COST}，但是你每关能选8种植物而不是7种！
1552.original: It'll cost you {UPGRADE_COST}, but you'll be able to choose 8 seeds per level instead of 7!

1601.text: 伙计，那些僵尸还在源源不断的来袭啊！
1601.original: Man, those zombies just keep a-comin'!

1602.text: 这次，我想替你挑些植物！
1602.original: This time around, I wanna pick some seeds for you!

2302.original: It's gonna be one heckuva fight!

2303.text: 听好，那么，我知道他的弱点是：
2303.original: Listen, though, I know what his weakness is:

2304.original: You have to hit him in the pancreas!

2305.original: No, that was a different guy...

2306.original: You have to... um... kick him in the...

2308.text: 你必须按 上上下下左右……
2308.original: You have to press up up down down left right...

2401.text: 我的名字叫疯狂的戴夫。

2402.text: 但你叫我疯狂的戴夫就行了。
2402.original: But you can just call me Crazy Dave.

2403.text: 听好，我有个惊喜要给你。
2403.original: Listen, I've got a surprise for you.

2404.text: 但是首先，你必须清理下你的草坪。
2404.original: But first, I'll need you to clear your lawn.

2405.text: 用你的铲子挖出那些植物！
2405.original: Use your shovel and dig up those plants!

2410.text: 好的，干得不错，现在给你个惊喜……
2410.original: Ok goody, now for the surprise...

2413.text: 为什么我要给你坚果墙？
2413.original: Why'd I put a wall-nut in your hand?{MOUTH_SMALL_OH}

2415.text: 现在出发！给我赢个冠军回来！
2415.original: NOW GO! BOWL ME A WINNER!{MOUTH_BIG_SMILE} {SCREAM}

2500.text: 我和我的哥们，弗莱科斯卡斯特?哈维，以前在无聊的时候就打花瓶。
2500.original: Me and my buddy Harvey Flaxcaster used to break vases when we were bored.

2501.text: 那么哈维不在镇上，正好你来和我一起吧，哈维二号！
2501.original: Well Harvey's outta town, so you're coming with me, Harvey #2!

2502.text: 就按照你的意愿去打破它吧，哈维！
2502.original: BREAK IT LIKE YOU MEAN IT, HARVEY! {SCREAM}

2700.text: 哥们，你把这些花瓶都打破了，干得漂亮！
2700.original: Man, you broke those vases nice and good!

2701.text: 用那些垃圾罐，像我砸我后面的铲子时，砸他们吧！
2701.original: Broke 'em like the time I broke my back digging through those trash cans!

2702.text: 来，我会给你更多花瓶的。
2702.original: Here, I brought you some more vases.

2703.original: Gotta be careful about breaking them too fast, though.

2704.text: 僵尸的数量太多了，你处理不了这么多的，哈哈。
2704.original: You don't wanna end up with more zombies than you can handle, huh huh.

2801.text: 这应该他们最后一波了。
2801.original: This should be the last of 'em.

2802.text: 把他们砸掉，然后你的工作就完成了！
2802.original: Break these, and you'll be all done!

601.text: 你找到了我的魔法玉米卷！

602.original: {SHOW_MONEYBAG}I must have it! I'll give you $1000!

604.text: 为什么我要花这么多钱买一个玉米卷？
604.original: Why'd I give you so much money for a taco?

606.text: 看看我的小店吧！我又进了一些新货！
606.original: Take a look around my shop! You'll notice I got some new items in stock!
